78296.subject: Region Spotlight: Nigeria
78296.body:
View this post on the web at https://www.team1.blog/p/region-spotlight-nigeria

Nigeria has long been recognized as a powerhouse of African developer talent and Web3 adoption. But turning that enthusiasm into real products with venture-ready protocols requires structure, a bridge between developer curiosity and long-term ecosystem support. 
Throughout 2026, Team1 Nigeria has been building that bridge by combining hands-on technical incubation, campus tours, real-world utility onboarding, and regional ecosystem grants.
Want to keep up with the latest in the Avalanche ecosystem? Subscribe to the Team1 blog and get our updates in your inbox weekly.
Global Recognition: Spotlighting Top 20 Build Games Finalists
The true test of any regional ecosystem is what its builders produce when given the right resources. On the global stage, Nigeria made its mark as two local teams placed in the Top 20 of the inaugural Avalanche Build Games out of more than 2,000 applicants worldwide.
Poll It [ https://substack.com/redirect/f19c4ed3-551e-4b09-b60d-6b735ea98fb0?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]: Building a permissionless perception market on Avalanche where users stake on crowd sentiment, and creators monetize activity. Pushing through every competitive stage into the Top 20, Poll It earned a $15,000 grant from Avalanche. Their early traction highlights real onchain utility, generating over $18,000 in volume across 251 polls and distributing thousands of dollars to creators and participants.
SliqPay [ https://substack.com/redirect/7e77b5a9-7876-48a4-a46a-34f66a7dac0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]: Tackling broken payment rails in Africa through simplified QR payments, phone/email transfers, bill splits, and merchant checkouts on Avalanche. SliqPay reached the Top 20 and secured a $10,000 grant from Avalanche as they prepare for mainnet deployment.
These teams represent what Build Games is all about: solving real problems, building consistently, and shipping actual products that bring value onchain.
Unlocking Regional Talent: The Grassroots Tour
To ensure these opportunities reached beyond major commercial hubs, Team1 Nigeria took the ecosystem directly to developer centers across the country.
In Uyo, over 60 builders gathered for an intensive incubation day focused on smart contract deployment and building in public. Experienced founders provided live feedback on product architectures, resulting in six live project applications submitted to Build Games on the spot.
In Awka, local developers explored Avalanche’s L1 architecture and downloaded Core Wallet to execute their first live onchain transactions. Similar momentum carried into Lagos and Ibadan, where a dedicated Developer Workshop guided participants through smart contract deployment and the application process for Team1 Mini Grants.
Showing Up Consistently: The Monthly Ecosystem Call

78295.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1120

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Monday! Today, we’re exploring the collapse of the Stripe-Advent bid for PayPal to see why Stripe refusing to stretch past $60.50 is the most important data point in the whole saga (the $7-9B gap that was never close, why PayPal's Q2 “beat" didn't change anything for buyers, a third buyer that was part of the original consortium and quietly dropped out before anyone knew, and what PayPal's board now has to prove every quarter to justify the cash it turned down + bonus deep dives into Stripe [ https://substack.com/redirect/78cf7181-29d5-4d23-a5ed-75774a594242?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], the latest PayPal’s financials [ https://substack.com/redirect/a4239147-fc5b-4056-916b-e9184a85a378?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & How to Turn Claude Fable 5 Into a McKinsey-Level Consulting Engine [ https://substack.com/redirect/c018bbbe-bed3-42f7-954f-62db464985f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and going to dive deep into Affirm's latest financials to see how the most profitable operator in BNPL just beat the top of its own guidance on every line (breaking down the most important facts & figures from Affirm's Q4 2026, including the 5.8% cost of funds that built every point of margin over 2 years and has now stopped moving, the fiscal 2027 guide that quietly assumes rates go the other way, & the two agentic-commerce launches that appear in no earnings document, to see whether $AFRM  is still worth your time & money + bonus deep dives into the latest financials of Klarna [ https://substack.com/redirect/30d5bf94-dba4-4eab-b114-d1f257223506?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & Nubank [ https://substack.com/redirect/a3b1165e-4d74-4584-8d73-2f48b77b5cac?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s jump straight into the interesting stuff 🌶️
PayPal rejected Stripe at $60.50. Now it trades at $53 😬📉
Following the money 💸 Two months ago we wrote that the offer price might be wrong, but  [ https://substack.com/redirect/1fe0d4be-174c-4e46-9511-fc2cca4602aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]the thesis [ https://substack.com/redirect/1fe0d4be-174c-4e46-9511-fc2cca4602aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] behind it wasn’t [ https://substack.com/redirect/1fe0d4be-174c-4e46-9511-fc2cca4602aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]. 77664.subject: Online check-in for a smooth take-off. ATTENTION! Don’t forget – it opens 24 hours before departure. (Y9SB5U)
77664.body:
Hello, Oleh Novosadov!

Your adventure is just around the corner – you’ll soon be boarding your Ryanair flight! There’s just one small step left to ensure a smooth start: online check-in.

It’s easy – do it via the Ryanair app. This way, you avoid unnecessary fees at the airport..

How to do it? Here’s a quick guide:

You will need:
- Booking code: Y9SB5U
- Booking email: novosadov@boarding.sk (it may differ from your personal email address)

If you’re using the Ryanair mobile app, you can check in directly there – it’s fast, convenient and eco-friendly.

When is check-in available?
- From 24 to 2 hours before departure
- If you’ve purchased seats, you can check in as early as 60 days before your flight

Download your boarding passes.

Save them in the app – you’ll need them when going through airport security. Before your trip, make sure your BOARDING PASSES (tickets) are in ELECTRONIC FORM. Download them to your phone.

You’ll find a full step-by-step guide with screenshots in our manual for checking in online via the Ryanair app.

ATTENTION! If you leave the check-in until the airport, it may cost you up to €55.

That’s a lot of money you could use for your next Pelikan adventure instead! Check our calendar of promotional flights and start planning your next trip right now!
